confirmed_removals.name: Blink49 Studios
confirmed_removals.note: Toronto-headquartered indie studio founded 2021 (LA office secondary) with Fifth Season as anchor investor, not a majority studio parent; blink49studios.com 301-redirects to its canonical site blink49.com - Canadian, so it fails the US-based criterion.

confirmed_removals.name: CPL Productions
confirmed_removals.note: London producer (Married At First Sight UK, A League of Their Own) majority-owned since 2012 by Red Arrow Studios, ProSiebenSat.1's production arm, and it extended that deal in 2021.

confirmed_removals.name: Monte-Carlo Acting Academy
confirmed_removals.note: An acting school in Monaco founded by Gabriele Greggio in 2024 selling courses and private coaching - a training business, not a production company at all.

confirmed_removals.name: Riff Raff Entertainment
confirmed_removals.note: riffraffentertainment.com is the official site of Jude Law and Ben Jackson's film/TV company, but it is London-based (9A Dallington Street, EC1V), not US; active with Black Rabbit (Netflix) and The Order (2024).

confirmed_removals.name: Mandeville Films
confirmed_removals.note: Todd Lieberman split off in 2022 and David Hoberman relaunched the operation as Hobie Films with a Lionsgate deal in Feb 2023; mandfilms.com is theirs but frozen at copyright 2019 with newest projects circa 2019.

confirmed_removals.name: DECKER'S DREAM | CONTENT STUDIO
confirmed_removals.note: YouTube-channel-style name matching Decker's Dream (deckersdreamhomes.com), a rental business offering six themed creator/photo studio spaces whose only contact is a +234 Nigerian WhatsApp number - a studio-space rental, not a production company, and no domain was listed to verify.

confirmed_removals.name: Cosmo Street
confirmed_removals.note: Cosmo Street Editorial Inc. (founded 1994, Santa Monica/Culver City CA, offices in NY/LA/Miami/Chicago) is a post-production editorial house cutting commercials and features, not an originating production company.

confirmed_removals.name: Premeditated Productions
confirmed_removals.note: The news-sourced company is the Hollywood film/TV shingle founded 2024 by Entangled Publishing CEO Liz Pelletier and producer Sherryl Clark with a first-look deal at Amazon MGM (extended through 2032), but premeditatedproductions.com belongs to an unrelated Las Vegas event-entertainment firm operating since 1991.

confirmed_removals.name: Riff Raff Films, Inc.
confirmed_removals.note: Riff Raff is a London-headquartered independent commercials/music-video production company founded by Matthew Fone; the AICP-listed Inc. is its US arm (riffrafffilms.tv/us in LA), and it is clearly active (launched an animation department in May 2026).

confirmed_removals.name: Sunset Gower Studios
confirmed_removals.note: It is a 12-soundstage Hollywood studio lot/rental facility, not a production company, owned since 2007 by Hudson Pacific Properties (in a JV with Blackstone) whose Sunset Studios brand site sunsetstudios.com covers this lot.

confirmed_removals.name: Teton Gravity Research
confirmed_removals.note: Jackson Hole WY action-sports film/media company (founded 1996, still active at tetongravity.com), but Lonely Planet Global (NC2 Media) took a strategic stake in 2015 and PitchBook/CB Insights record a 65% majority acquisition (2020), so it is majority-owned rather than fully independent, though founders Steve and Todd Jones remain co-CEOs.

confirmed_removals.name: The Sweet Shop Films LLC
confirmed_removals.note: The Sweetshop is an independent global commercial production company (B Corp certified as The Sweet Shop Holdings Limited) headquartered in Ponsonby, Auckland NZ; the AICP LLC is its Los Angeles US arm and thesweetshop.tv is its official site with offices in Auckland, Sydney, Bangkok, London and LA.

confirmed_removals.name: CMS Productions
confirmed_removals.note: Marina del Rey, CA firm at cmsproductions.com that sells back-office production SUPPORT services (payroll, accounting, insurance, union signatory for SAG-AFTRA/WGA/IATSE) — it does not develop or produce its own content, so it is not a co-production candidate.

confirmed_removals.name: Blue Ant Studios
confirmed_removals.note: Blue Ant Studios is the production/rights division of Toronto-headquartered, TSX-listed Blue Ant Media (encompassing Insight Productions, Proper Television, Jam Filled), so it is Canadian and not independent; blueantstudios.com is its official site.

confirmed_removals.name: Kinetic Content
confirmed_removals.note: Santa Monica unscripted producer of Love Is Blind and Married at First Sight, but it was owned by Red Arrow Studios (ProSiebenSat.1) and since 2022 sits under Peter Chernin's The North Road Company, so it is not independent; kineticcontent.com is its official site.

confirmed_removals.name: Merchant Ivory Productions
confirmed_removals.note: Legacy NY-based company of the late Ismail Merchant (d. 2005) and James Ivory (now 98): no completed feature since 2009, the brand and 30-title library were sold to Cohen Media Group in 2015, and merchantivory.com is a heritage site citing only long-gestating development projects (Richard II).

confirmed_removals.name: Showtime
confirmed_removals.note: Premium cable network owned by Paramount, rebranded 'Paramount+ With Showtime' in Jan 2024; the listed domain 301-redirects to paramountplus.com/brands/showtime/, confirming it is Paramount's Showtime brand, not an independent production company.

refuted_removals.name: 5-Second Films
refuted_removals.note: LA comedy film collective (LLC) whose site copyright is frozen at 2008-2012 and whose daily releases ended in Dec 2013; only sporadic output since (feature Dude Bro Party Massacre III, 2015), so effectively dormant.

clean.name: Chelsea
clean.note: chelsea.com is Chelsea (formerly Chelsea Pictures), a NY/LA commercial production company and AICP Commercial Agreement signatory with an Emmy for Outstanding Commercial - not the football club.

clean.name: Anonymous Content
clean.note: LA management/production company still operating independently (Darren Walker just named CEO); Laurene Powell Jobs' Emerson Collective holds a controlling equity stake but is an investment firm, not a major studio - note it is a large powerhouse, not a small shop.

clean.name: Tomorrow
clean.note: tomorrow.tv is Tomorrow, an independent LA/Brooklyn commercial production company (clients incl. GM, Nike, Prudential) with a live site and AICP listing; it makes ad/branded content, not scripted TV formats.

clean.name: Moving Picture Institute
clean.note: New York 501(c)(3) nonprofit film production company/talent incubator promoting 'freedom through film' (2024 revenue $8.1M, active filings) - mission-driven ideological nonprofit, not a commercial co-production partner.

clean.name: Washington Square Films
clean.note: NYC/LA independent founded 1995 by Joshua Blum; served as the NY production company on Almodovar's The Room Next Door (2024) and wsfilms.com carries recent director-signing news.

clean.name: Smartypants Pictures
clean.note: Brooklyn NY production company (36 Waverly Ave) founded 2014 by Oscar-winning filmmaker Joshua Seftel; AICP member with a live site at smartypants.nyc listing current team and clients like Delta and National Geographic.

clean.name: The Asylum
clean.note: Burbank CA independent studio with 500+ films since 1997 (Sharknado, mockbusters); Sharknado Origins is in development targeting a summer 2026 release, and theasylum.cc is its long-standing official site.

clean.name: Radicalmedia
clean.note: Independent NYC-headquartered media/production company founded 1993 by Jon Kamen and Frank Scherma, active in 2025 (AICP Week, press interviews) - but it is a large global operation with offices in LA, London, Berlin and Shanghai, so it fails TVF's 'small' criterion.

clean.name: Bottle Rocket 360, LLC
clean.note: Santa Monica commercial/documentary production company operating since 2006 with a live site and current AICP directory listing, though the site still shows COVID-era protocol text; distinct from Chicago's unrelated Bottle Rocket Media.

clean.name: Hungry Man, Inc.
clean.note: Independent commercial production company founded 1997 by Bryan Buckley and Hank Perlman, ranked #4 on Ad Age's 2026 Production A-List with offices in NY/LA/London/Rio/Sao Paulo — active and independent but a top-five global commercial shop, so not small.

clean.name: Insignia Films
clean.note: NYC documentary production company founded 1988 by Stephen Ives (his founder page is on insigniafilms.com); site carries a 2024 copyright and a current slate including Mr. Polaroid for PBS, with additional offices now in Nairobi and Stockholm.

clean.name: Ironbound Films
clean.note: Garrison, NY documentary and branded-content production company (founded 2003, Kramer/Miller/Newberger) whose 2024 feature documentary Blind Spot confirms current activity.

clean.name: K Films, Inc.
clean.note: Small LA commercial production company run by Warren Kushner; kfilms.us is live with working contact emails, but the newest dated portfolio work is from 2018, leaving current operation genuinely ambiguous.

clean.name: Liam Films, Inc.
clean.note: Liam Films, Inc. of South Pasadena CA is the legal entity behind the trading name Liam Labs (same 1512 Indiana Ave address and same principal Alfredo de Villa), a small diversity-led commercial/branded video studio with a live site at liamlabs.com and clients like Chevrolet and Bud Light.

clean.name: Ruckus Films
clean.note: Comedy-forward US commercial production boutique founded by director J.J. Adler with Mino Jarjoura as Managing Director; ruckusfilms.com is its site (copyright 2026, director roster) and recent SHOOTonline news of signing directing duo BLOK confirms it is active — note it makes ads, not scripted series.

clean.name: Tool
clean.note: Tool of North America is an independent Santa Monica commercial/creative production company (founded 1995) at toolofna.com, named an Ad Age A-List standout production company for 2024 and still hiring staff in late 2025 — note it makes ads/branded content, not scripted TV.

clean.name: Whitewater Films
clean.note: Los Angeles independent film/TV production company founded 1997 by director Rick Rosenthal (Halloween II), focused on emerging filmmakers; whitewaterfilms.com is its own site and shows maintenance as recent as February 2025.

clean.name: Bronson Canyon Pictures
clean.note: Real LA scripted-TV production company founded by Jeffrey Levine (ex-Fremantle SVP) that signed a multi-year FIRST-LOOK deal with Fox Entertainment Studios in 2025 — a deal, not ownership, so it remains independent; bronsoncanyonpictures.com lists Levine p.g.a. in Los Angeles.

clean.name: Heaven
clean.note: Heaven, Inc. is an independent Los Angeles creative production company (advertising and music videos) with an AICP member listing and a director roster including J.A. Bayona on its own site heaveninc.us; active Instagram presence — commercial-focused rather than scripted TV.

clean.name: Liebling
clean.note: Full-service motion and stills production company run by New York-based producer Disco Meisch, serving fashion/brand clients (Vogue, Isabel Marant, Stella McCartney) across US and Europe; hello-liebling.com/about confirms — a fashion/commercial shop, not a scripted-content producer, and distinct from the dissolved UK 'Liebling Productions Ltd'.

clean.name: Sycamore Studios
clean.note: Privately held Los Angeles animation studio founded August 2024 by Christian McGuigan and Timothy Reckart with no parent company, actively developing family animated features (Doctor Dolittle: King of the Wild, Madeline, InvestiGators, Zita the Spacegirl); sycamorestudios.com is its site.

clean.name: 87North Productions
clean.note: Founded 2019 by David Leitch and Kelly McCormick in LA; holds a first-look deal with Universal (not ownership) and set up the spec 'Fight' there in April 2025, with 87north.com serving as its official site.

clean.name: Imaginary Forces
clean.note: Independent LA/NY creative studio founded 1996 by Frankfurt, Houghton and Cooper, best known for main-title design (Stranger Things, Mad Men, Foundation) and commercials rather than scripted entertainment production; imaginaryforces.com is its site and it remains active (AICP-listed).

clean.name: Pinnacle Peak Pictures
clean.note: Faith-based indie studio (Scottsdale, AZ) formerly Pure Flix Entertainment, renamed after Sony's AFFIRM bought only the Pure Flix streaming service/brand in 2020, leaving the production company independent; pinnaclepeakpictures.com shows current 2026 releases and Cannes/AFM activity.

clean.name: Severin Films
clean.note: LA-based independent founded 2006, but primarily a boutique cult-film restoration/home-video label (350+ title library) that produces occasional documentaries (Enter the Clones of Bruce, Tribeca 2023) rather than scripted series; severin-films.com 301-redirects to its official severinfilms.com.

clean.name: Surge of Power Enterprises
clean.note: Micro-budget independent LLC (organized 2003, founder Vincent J. Roth) behind the 'Surge of Power' gay-superhero films; surgeofpower.org is its official site with a 2025 copyright, a new 'Where There's Smoke' trailer, and a 2026 Q CON convention appearance showing it is still operating.

clean.name: Temple Hill Entertainment
clean.note: Independently owned LA (plus London office) production company founded 2006 by Wyck Godfrey and Marty Bowen; it holds first-look deals (Paramount film, Lionsgate TV) but is not a subsidiary, and with Twilight/Maze Runner/Smile ($5.8B box office) it is a major-scale indie rather than a small shop; templehillent.com is its official site.
